original.target_description: Teen FQS friendship quality, Treatment versus Delayed Treatment Control, baseline-to-posttest Condition X Time interaction.

n.sample_role: Adolescent participants in the two mutually exclusive final treatment/control groups contributing teen self-report and parent-rated outcomes, compared at weeks 1 and 12.
n.exclusions: Three additional participants dropped out before completion: one never started, one left after anxiety in the first session, and one was discontinued for missing more than three sessions (p. 598). Two pilot groups of six were excluded from the present study (p. 600). No additional missingness is reported for these teen/parent outcomes; teacher missingness concerns separate analyses.
n.location: p. 599 Participant Assignment and Outcome Assessment; p. 603 Table 4 (final outcome group sizes); pp. 598, 600 exclusions

notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: title Parent-Assisted Social Skills Training to Improve Friendships in Teens with Autism Spectrum Disorders; Elizabeth A. Laugeson, Fred Frankel, Catherine Mogil, Ashley R. Dillon; DOI 10.1007/s10803-008-0664-5; ORIGINAL PAPER; journal 39:596–606 (2009), published online 18 November 2008. Full primary article text includes methods, results, tables, discussion, appendix and references. No PDF was supplied. Target correspondence established from outcome names, instrument definitions, Results p. 602 and Table 4 p. 603, not input order or numeric matching. Analytic N arithmetic: Treatment 17 + Delayed Treatment Control 16 = 33 adolescent participants. These are the final mutually exclusive groups printed for the target pre/post outcomes in Table 4, not a sum of participants and informants. Parent ratings concern those same adolescents, not additional participants. Three noncompleters and 12 pilot participants are excluded. Unassigned fields/sides are null placeholders.
